case.summary: An analyst review of transaction 3478561 on card C13487-K1 revealed a fraudulent $74.96 purchase where the one-time passcode was not completed and the cardholder confirmed they still hold the card. The connection used an anonymous proxy, and the device profile was linked to 28 cards with confirmed fraud cases. The verdict is fraud involving an undocumented pattern with an exposure of $439.61. The final actions are: BLOCK_CARD (L1), CREATE_CASE (auto), MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS (auto), FILE_REPORT (L2), and ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST (auto).

sar.narrative: Customer C13487, holder of card C13487-K1, is the subject of this suspicious activity report regarding online transactions totaling $439.61 processed between 2016-11-15 20:30 and 2016-11-26 17:39. Specifically, three transactions were conducted on the account: $112.37 on 2016-11-15 20:30 (transaction 3460634), $74.96 on 2016-11-22 16:11 (transaction 3478561), and $252.28 on 2016-11-26 17:39 (transaction 3489320). These payments originated online from device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' routed through an anonymous proxy (IP_PROXY:ANONYMOus). This exact device profile was simultaneously used across 28 cards in a 60-day window, with every instance flagged as a new device behind an anonymous or hidden proxy, indicating a shared cyber-enabled fraud infrastructure. Furthermore, the one-time passcode sent to the cardholder's registered phone was not completed for the session that made the $74.96 purchase, and when contacted separately, the cardholder confirmed they did not make the transactions and still physically holds the card. The activity is highly suspicious because 4 closed cases on cards using this device profile were confirmed fraud under an undocumented pattern, and 8 of the most similar closed cases—including CC-0849, CC-3035, CC-2971, and CC-2985—were also confirmed fraud. In response to these findings, the bank has executed automated actions including creating a case, monitoring connected cards, and escalating to an analyst, while placing pending block requests on the card and filing this report.
